# v2.0.54

## Release Workflow Fix

- Fixed the GitHub Actions release-notes resolver so the fallback body no longer uses an indented heredoc that Bash rejects with exit code `2`.
- Updated `actions/checkout` to `v5` for the Node 24 runtime.
- Updated `softprops/action-gh-release` to `v3` for the Node 24 runtime.
- Bumped the application package metadata to `2.0.54`.

## Notes

- This release replaces the failed `v2.0.53` release publish attempt with a workflow-compatible patch version.
